updates.title: NMPA releases draft revision of medical device cleanliness validation guideline
updates.summary: Draft revision adds stricter endotoxin and particulate matter thresholds for implanted orthopedic devices; public comment window 60 days.

updates.title: FDA CDRH updates 510(k) submission template for software in medical devices
updates.summary: New template clarifies cybersecurity documentation and predicate selection for SaMD-adjacent hardware; effective for submissions filed after 2026-11-01.

updates.title: EU MDCG publishes guidance on UDI issuance for reusable instruments
updates.summary: Clarifies UDI-DI requirements and reprocessing documentation for reusable surgical instruments; affects legacy SKUs due for recertification.

updates.title: PMDA streamlines foreign manufacturer accreditation renewal
updates.summary: Renewal dossier now accepts digital signatures and reduces review clock for low-risk Class I/II devices.
